scope: Camera mamepa (Mamba-JEPA over the sensory tap's frame embeddings) as the retention fix for the native video stream. Code: branch claude/camera-mamepa on top of claude/native-video-stream 2369e1fd. In the scored arm the video prompt gets the mamepa's summary as a note before the question and the answer sees frames from the mamepa's onset (start of the present happening, at least two frames) onward. Nothing else in the answer path changes.
registered_before_scoring: 2026-11-13, before any AEON embedding of the training data was computed, before the development check and before any fresh clip was generated
queue: one lock hold under ~/physics-lab/train.lock, started only after the native-video fourth chain (gates4, waiter pid 46322) has finished; no queue jumping; one heavy GPU job at a time

training.data: synthetic only: camera_mamepa_train.synthetic_clip (own generator, seeds 7300000000+), 384 train / 48 selection / 48 test clips of 32 frames, encoded through the checkpoint's own vision projection (mean of 70 soft tokens). No registered evaluation seed, live frame, recording or downloaded video.
training.objective: JEPA: predict the whitened latent of frames 1, 2 and 4 ahead from the carried SSM state; within-scene targets only; projection fixed (PCA-whitened, 64 axes); AdamW 1e-3 / 0.05, 30 epochs, early stopping on the selection split
training.keep_rule: the SSM forecaster is kept only if its test-split loss (numpy inference path) is >= 5% below persistence; otherwise the checkpoint carries the fixed forecasters only. err_scale = median best-forecaster error on within-scene test transitions.

development_choice_rule: development clips only (resampler-development, seed 2026111322, 128 clips, 20 shape-free stills seeds 900000+i then the motion clip): run the mamepa arm with boundary 5, 10 and 20 on the same sessions; choose the highest development accuracy, ties to 10; write mamepa-choice.json before the fresh clips are generated; use it unchanged

clips.generator: the Codex's moving-square generator, unchanged (copied byte for byte); four 192x192 frames at 2 fps; 70 soft tokens per frame

rules: retention: mamepa arm on apple5-B (20 stills first, default window) >= 0.688 AND >= stream_primary(apple5-B) - 0.05
motion (no regression): mamepa arm on the plain clips >= MLX-native bulk reference - 0.03 on apple5-A and apple5-B; reference parses on >= 90%

latency: p95 per-frame mamepa time < 0.1 s AND p95 over apple5-B questions of (first-token time with the note and view - first-token time without, same session, order alternated) + summary build time < 0.1 s
text parity (no regression): stream forward vs the NativeMind text route on the first 2,000 unique reviewed-eleven inputs by sha256: 0 argmax mismatches and maximum absolute error 0

vision (no regression): the original GGUF battery re-run on an owned loopback process (stopped afterwards) >= 19/22 with no lost cases; the stream-path diagnostic with recall on (one 280-token frame) reported

adoption: none by this run: RECALL_DEFAULT stays False and nothing is merged to the deploy branch or deployed; Gloria decides after the numbers
